Operational Description: Door is normally closed and unlocked. Free entry when room is not in use; pushing actuator opens the door. Free egress at all times; pushing actuator opens the door. Upon loss of power operator is disabled. Battery backup provides power upon loss of power to ensure door remains locked if in use. If the interior "Push to Lock" button has been pushed, exterior actuator is disabled and door is locked. If the interior "Push to Lock" button has been pushed, it lights up and also lights up exterior occupancy indicator. Door is unlocked and system is reset by pushing "Push to Lock" button a second time or opening the door from the interior.

components.description: Push to Lock Button Shared with D147A

sets.notes: Operational Description: Door is normally closed and locked Valid card allows entry when room is not in use or D147A is not open; pushing actuator opens the door. Valid key allows entry but does not activate exterior actuator. Free egress at all times; pushing actuator opens the door. Upon loss of power, operator is disabled and door remains locked. If the interior "Push to Lock" button has been pushed, exterior actuator and card reader for D147A and D147B are disabled. If the interior "Push to Lock" button has been pushed, both interior "Push to Lock" buttons illuminate and exterior occupancy indicators illuminate for D147A and D147B. Card reader is reactivated for both D147A and D147B and system is reset by pushing "Push to Lock" button a second time or opening the door from the interior.
